title: When Two Become One: Conformational Changes in FXR/RXR Heterodimers Bound to Steroidal Antagonists.
authors: Diaz-Holguin, Alejandro; Rashidian, Azam; Pijnenburg, Dirk; Monteiro Ferreira, Glaucio; Stefela, Alzbeta; Kaspar, Miroslav; Kudova, Eva; Poso, Antti; van Beuningen, Rinie; Pavek, Petr; Kronenberger, Thales
one_liner_zh: 该文用微秒级分子动力学模拟研究FXR/RXR异源二聚体与甾体拮抗剂结合后的构象变化，虽非TF-DNA体系，但属于核受体蛋白-DNA互作相关的大分子复合物动态结合机制建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Farnesoid X receptor (FXR) is a nuclear receptor with an essential role in regulating bile acid synthesis and cholesterol homeostasis. FXR activation by agonists is explained by an alphaAF-2-trapping mechanism; however, antagonism mechanisms are diverse. We discuss microsecond molecular dynamics (MD) simulations investigating our recently reported FXR antagonists 2a and 2 h. We study the antagonist-induced conformational changes in the FXR ligand-binding domain, when compared to the synthetic (GW4064) or steroidal (chenodeoxycholic acid, CDCA) FXR agonists in the FXR monomer or FXR/RXR heterodimer r, and in the presence and absence of the coactivator. Our MD data suggest ligand-specific influence on conformations of different FXR-LBD regions, including the alpha5/alpha6 region, alphaAF-2, and alpha9-11. Changes in the heterodimerization interface induced by antagonists seem to be associated with alphaAF-2 destabilization, which prevents both co-activator and co-repressor recruitment. Our results provide new insights into the conformational behaviour of FXR, suggesting that FXR antagonism/agonism shift requires a deeper assessment than originally proposed by crystal structures.
abstract_zh: 法尼醇X受体（FXR）是一种核受体，在调节胆汁酸合成和胆固醇稳态中发挥关键作用。激动剂对FXR的激活通过alphaAF-2捕获机制解释；然而，拮抗机制多种多样。我们讨论了微秒级分子动力学（MD）模拟，研究我们最近报道的FXR拮抗剂2a和2h。我们研究了拮抗剂诱导的FXR配体结合域构象变化，与合成（GW4064）或甾体（鹅去氧胆酸，CDCA）FXR激动剂在FXR单体或FXR/RXR异二聚体中，以及在辅激活因子存在和不存在的情况下进行比较。我们的MD数据表明，配体对FXR-LBD不同区域（包括alpha5/alpha6区域、alphaAF-2和alpha9-11）的构象具有特异性影响。拮抗剂诱导的异二聚化界面变化似乎与alphaAF-2去稳定化相关，这阻止了辅激活因子和辅抑制因子的招募。我们的结果为FXR的构象行为提供了新见解，表明FXR拮抗/激动转换需要比晶体结构最初提出的更深入的评估。
